# ADR-0001: Use UV for project management

> **Status:** accepted | **Date:** 2026-01-23

## Context

The project needs a way to manage dependencies
convieniently and reliable.

## Decision

Use UV for project management.

## Consequences

Positive: Easier to work with than without project manager. Better than other project managers.
Negative: None
